reuse.why: The change reuses findOrCreateBank, syncAccount and response handling, but copies provider orchestration and local unlink logic.

duplication.why: Fintegra duplicates an existing linking workflow and transaction downloader, while replacement duplicates unlinkAccount's field-reset block.

placement.why: Provider integration follows the existing module boundaries, but an assertion helper now also performs account mutations.

scope.why: The edits are confined to the requested linking rules, Fintegra integration and corresponding release notes.

maintainability.why: Centralized link validation helps maintenance, but copied workflows and mutation hidden behind an assertion name make future changes harder to reason about.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Existing reusable bank lookup and sync abstractions are used; unlinkAccount includes provider removal and cannot directly serve the required local-only replacement.

disguised_duplication.where: The duplicated linking, downloading and unlink-reset blocks are direct copies rather than disguised rewrites.

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains the replaceExistingLink parameter, three upgrade-target branches (target supplied, missing target, closed target), and local unlink mutations; all six provider handlers call it.
